answer: A practical defense ties each agent identity to a verifiable kernel of costly, ongoing work, not a free account name. Like boats that must actually dock at a jetty before trading, an agent earns reputation only after completing checkable tasks and staking resources slashed on fraud. Newcomers start with limited rights and rise toward summit-level privileges only as their auditable record grows, so thousands of fake identities buy no influence: each copy must pay the same cost and build history from scratch.
